system.description:
A guardian of the Nalwood Forest, answerable to Arikh Evergreen's Cabal.

  • Old-Growth Instinct: Advantage on Conceal checks in dense woodland or old-growth forest. Your first attack from Conceal each encounter in woodland adds your full Combat Marauder bonus, whatever the target's type.
  • Cabal Kinship: Advantage on checks identifying forest creatures, finding paths through the Nalwood, and communicating with Cabal druids.
